# Lucachinou (Luca)

> 17-year-old French AI Engineer building open-source projects:
> Machine Learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow, SpaCy), server administration tools and bots.
> Main languages: Python, Rust and Java.

## Profile

- **Name**: Luca, known online as **Lucachinou**
- **Age**: 17 (born in 2009)
- **Role**: self-taught AI Engineer, open-source contributor
- **Languages spoken**: French, English
- **Website**: https://lucachinou.github.io/

## Skills

- **Python**: Machine Learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow, SpaCy), automation, real-time rendering (OpenGL), bots
- **Java**: plugins and tools for the Minecraft ecosystem, back-end
- **JavaScript**: Discord bots (Node.js) and lightweight web interfaces
- **Rust**: system tools and performance

## Projects

- [3D Engine](https://github.com/Lucachinou/3dEngine): open-source 3D rendering
  engine written in Python and based on OpenGL.
- [Singlecraft](https://github.com/Lucachinou/Singlecraft): open-source Minecraft
  server manager in Python, designed to be easy to use.
